entries.title: Crewmates on another computer can reach your integrations too
entries.body: A crewmate working on a computer that runs work for you can now reach your integrations, such as GitHub, the way crewmates on this computer do. It reads through your GitHub sign-in on this computer, which never leaves it, and a change it asks for still waits for your click on a card. Before, only crewmates on this computer had them.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen: a crewmate on another computer reaches the same integrations, and a change it asks for arrives as a card as before.
